thread:
maria: quick sync - we need a clear decision: add a first-class 'stability' field to model manifests or keep extending pins
jon: current pins are overloaded (owner/affinity/temp). fallback logic is messy
lee: seeing surprising fallbacks in Dedicated clusters when models are evicted
sasha: proposal A: add stability enum (stable|canary|experimental|deprecated) + optional stability_score (0.0-1.0). Proposal B: extend pin with typed annotations (pin.type, pin.priority)
maria: enum simplifies router policies; typed pins preserve backward shape but mean more interpretation code
jon: tenant-level exceptions? some customers want experimental models in specific regions
anya: prefer overrides in route config that reference model_id rather than mutating manifest
lee: separates control planes nicely. manifests stay hints, route configs hold overrides
sasha: migration note: field must be additive; clients must tolerate unknown enum values
maria: manifest.schema v2 draft: optional "stability" enum, optional "stability_score" float, optional "stability_reason" string
jon: telemetry update: emit model_stability and stability_score in traces and metrics
sasha: default mapping suggestion: stable=0.9, canary=0.7, experimental=0.4, deprecated=0.1; manifests can override score
lee: routing sketch: prefer explicit_pin -> tenant_affinity -> stability_weighted_select -> fallback_pool
anya: Dedicated wants weighted selection (cost-aware) not strict tiers, so numeric score helps
maria: rollout hints (transition windows, cohort ramps) should live in rollout metadata, not main manifest
jon: safety question: what does missing/unknown stability default to? BC hints stable, safety suggests experimental
sasha: recommend default missing/unknown -> experimental and emit CI warnings/alerts
maria: agreed consensus -> default to experimental; infra to add CI warning on missing field
deploy-bot: infra note - manifest.schema v2 will add optional stability field; CI warns when stability absent; infra will propose enforcement later
anya: i'll draft Dedicated migration guide covering tenant overrides and expected behavior
sasha: i'll open manifest.schema v2 PR with enum+score+reason (owner: @sasha) aiming EOD Friday
jon: i'll update router policy docs to include stability_score weighting (owner: @jon)
lee: i'll add tracing change to emit model_stability and stability_score (owner: @lee)
maria: small operational rule: deprecated must be advisory only, not auto-evict/delete
lee: sdk adapters should expose stability in model listings and allow filtering by min_stability_score
jon: adding SDK issue
maria: sync Friday 10:00 after Sasha PR. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
